sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN product AS p ON p.product_id = o.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-01-01 00:00:00';
